WITH rep_counts AS (
  SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
  FROM Customer c
  JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId
  GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City
), compared AS (
  SELECT EmployeeId, City, customer_count,
         AVG(customer_count) OVER (PARTITION BY City) AS city_average,
         SUM(customer_count) OVER () AS matched_customer_total
  FROM rep_counts
), kept AS (
  SELECT City, customer_count, city_average, matched_customer_total
  FROM compared
  WHERE customer_count > city_average
)
SELECT City,
       SUM(customer_count) AS total_customers,
       AVG(customer_count - city_average) AS average_excess,
       AVG(1.0 * customer_count / matched_customer_total) AS average_share
FROM kept
GROUP BY City;
